answer: A useful defense is to require each agent to post a bond that can be slashed when its claims fail independent checks. The checks might compare signed task receipts with randomly sampled work, while limiting how much influence newly funded identities receive until they build a track record. A reef of bonded agents can be mapped like an orchard, with pigment marking verified contributions; the metaphor is cosmetic, but the mechanism makes each fake identity require locked capital and exposes bad actors to losing it.
